# ColorPalette

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A Tailwind v4 colour ramp: eleven fixed shade stops (50 → 950) addressed by index, e.g. `ColorPalette.Red[500]`.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.
